result.title: Med-Agentic: Distilling Agentic Medical Reasoning with Internalized Meta-Capabilities
result.summary: Large language models (LLMs) in expert domains face a trade-off between agentic tool use, which externalizes expertise behind brittle multi-turn runtimes, and end-to-end specialization, which internalizes expertise only implicitly at task-level granularity. We propose internalized meta-capabilities: atomic, parametrically internalized, and composable reasoning units that an LLM can select and combine within a single chain-of-thought (CoT). We instantiate this idea as Med-Agentic for medical visual diagnosis, where the model emits a capability-tagged structured CoT in one forward pass, turning capability invocation into tagged token generation rather than external tool calls. For training, Med-OPD performs multi-teacher on-policy distillation with token-level dual-factor teacher routing conditioned on both the image and the active capability tag, strictly generalizing per-prompt teacher routing. We show that this routing gives an unbiased estimator of the same expected teacher-KL gradient. Across public medical imaging datasets spanning nine anatomies and eight modalities, Med-Agentic consistently improves in-distribution and out-of-distribution diagnostic accuracy over the strong competitors.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Med-Agentic：把医学视觉诊断中的 agentic 工具调用内化为带能力标签的结构化 CoT，使模型在一次前向中生成标签式「能力调用」，并用多教师 on-policy 蒸馏（以图像与当前标签为条件的 token 级双因子教师路由）训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 能力标签化 CoT 接近「何时 LOOK／何时推理」的显式调度，token 级教师路由为监督粒度与贡献分配提供可核查线索；但推理状态仍是文本 token，不涉及 latent 表示与动态计算，需读原文确认。
